> Tracker · Pipeliners · 2026-06-23

# Summary
The first page inventory spreadsheet, built 2026-06-23. A master overview of core, service, city and blog URLs with title, page type, target keyword, meta fields, an "Indexed?" check (from a site: search proxy, to be confirmed in GSC), last updated date, status and notes. It was later superseded by the Website Pages tracker artifact.

# Key facts
- Core and Service tab (22 rows): homepage target "trenchless pipe repair phoenix", /services/ "trenchless sewer services phoenix", /services-areas/ "pipe repair service areas arizona", and the service pages (/trenchless-drain-pipe-repair/, /hydro-jetting/, /epipe-restoration/, /leak-detection-services-in-phoenix-arizona/, /pipelining-methods-phoenix/, /trenchless-pipe-repair-service-areas-in-arizona/, /phoenix-sewer-line-problems/).
- The leak detection service page was flagged "live but not surfacing in index", top priority to submit in GSC.
- Per-service tabs and blog rows follow (truncated in this summary).
- A 404 row was fixed in this file during the June 22-23 session.
